versionHistory.intro: A project snapshot records every file as it was at one moment. Restoring a snapshot puts the whole project back; a single file's history lives in that file's Version history.

versionHistory.confirmUndoAIEdit: Undo this AI edit? Your text goes back to how it was before the edit; all existing versions are kept.
versionHistory.fileVersionLimitTitle: This file's version history is full
